description:
Further your career at Ball, a world leader in manufacturing sustainable aluminium packaging. Achieve extraordinary things when you join our team, and make a difference in your professional development, the community, and around the globe!

Please, submit your resume in English.

Ball Corporation is looking for a well-rounded team player with broad technical leadership skills to add to our Global IT Security operations department. This position requires extensive knowledge in three or more of the following IT Security tools: Firewalls and firewall management systems, Web Content Filtering (URL Filtering), Web Application and Malware Protection, Intrusion Prevention System (IPS), SSL Decryption, Email Security, Strong Authentication, Remote Access, End Point Protection, Advanced Threat Management (APT), Vulnerability Scanning & Remediation, Identity Management, Data Loss Prevention, Data Encryption, Global DNS, Security Incident Management (SIM), Public Key Infrastructure, Web Application Firewall / Proxy, IT Security Forensics, Password Vaulting, Risk assessment, security vulnerability assessment.

This position works within the Global IT Security team to solve complex IT Security problems by taking a broad perspective to identify innovative technical solutions. The successful candidate will provide mentorship and guidance to junior level cyber security analysts. The position also participates in managing our vendors to achieve the desired results including quality and on-time delivery. Working knowledge and relevant certifications in the above security tools is preferred.

Essential Responsible Areas

  • Security administration is a hands-on role that requires a high level of technical expertise including networking, operating systems, applications, cloud environments and security.
  • Responsible for a broad range of security tasks, including the day-to-day security administration of network security devices, as well as the management of technologies, such as firewall, intrusion detection, intrusion prevention, data loss prevention, antivirus, anti-spam, antispyware, and security information and event management (SIEM) tools.
  • Monitor, analyze, and respond to security incidents and breaches swiftly and effectively, minimizing potential impact.
  • Lead incident response efforts, coordinate investigations, and ensure all incidents are properly documented and reported.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert on cybersecurity matters, both internally and externally.
  • Conduct regular security audits and assessments to identify weaknesses in networks, systems, and applications, and recommend remediation actions.
  • Create and maintain system and network diagrams as well as process documentation.
  • Opportunity to solve complex installation and integration challenges while documenting both solutions, analysis, and alternatives.
  • Provide support to ensure planning and deployment is accomplished in coordination with system owners, engineers and stakeholders and are consistent with appropriate infrastructure and security engineering requirements.
  • Assess and prioritize cybersecurity risks and vulnerabilities across the organization's technology landscape.
  • Follow up on remediation of vulnerabilities.
  • Participate in design and implementation of new security controls.
  • Stay current with cybersecurity threats and trends, providing ongoing intelligence and insights to inform security decision-making.
  • Create and modify procedural documentation as needed.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure compliance with regulatory standards and frameworks, such as SOX, HIPAA, or NIST.
  • Develop and maintain incident response plans, disaster recovery plans, and business continuity strategies to ensure resilience in the face of cybersecurity threats.
  • Ensure that all information systems operate in accordance to set standards.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation with department.
  • Establish and maintain effective working relationships within the department, the Strategic Business Unit/Strategic Support Unit and the Company. Interact appropriately with others in order to maintain a positive and productive work environment.

Main Requirements/Knowledge

  • Completed Bachelor's Degree.
  • Advanced Level of English.
  • Experience in a cyber-security operations environment including 4+ years of technical leadership.
  • CISSP, CISM, CISA certifications preferred; other security relevant certifications considered (e.g. SANS GIAC-GSEC, GCED, GCFW, GCIA, GCIH, GISP, GSLC).
  • Knowledge of CISCO ASA solutions specifically remote access.
  • Technical “hands-on” proficiency with at least three security-related systems and applications (Vulnerability software, next generation firewalls, IDS/IPS, SIEM, Data Loss Prevention).
  • Technical proficiency with security-related systems and applications, especially mainstream OS’s (e.g. Microsoft Windows and Linux), Vulnerability Scanners, SIEM, and anti-malware tools, user provisioning systems and intrusion detection, automated policy compliance, and desktop security tools.
  • Experience in documenting and maintaining processes and procedures.
  • Knowledge of information security principles, including risk assessment, intrusion detection, network access control (NAC), encryption, threat and vulnerability management.
  • Knowledge of network infrastructure, including routers, switches, firewalls, VPN, and associated network protocols and concepts; CCNA preferred.
  • Knowledge of SANS Twenty Critical Controls information security policies, procedures, guidelines, and methodologies desired.
  • A strong familiarity with cryptographic concepts and their practical application.
  • Experience in securing Cloud environments such as Azure, AWS, SAP, etc.
  • Knowledge and Understanding of the CI/CD Pipeline along with tools such as Jenkins and Bamboo.
  • Experience in driving technology solutions in large, complex organizations.
  • Proven focus in metrics-driven delivery: defining Service Level Agreements (SLAs), monitoring SLAs, enhancing environment to meet SLAs.
  • Experience in driving process and technology re-engineering using industry practices e.g., COBIT, ITIL, CMMi.

description:
The Role:

We're looking for an experienced credit research analyst to join our Debtwire Credit Research Team. The team provides unique insights and valuation analysis on companies and their securities that are restructuring, in the process of a transforming event or raising capital. Key tasks will include reviewing financial statements and legal documents to produce detailed credit research on stressed, distressed, and restructuring companies. The analysis will be produced in reports produced for subscribers of Debtwire, an ION Analytics subsidiary.

You will have the option to work remotely, including a flexible contract and competitive rates.


Key Responsibilities:
  • Produce Credit Reports that provide financial and valuation analysis on high-yield, distressed and stressed companies.
  • Interact with subscribers electronically and personally to discuss credit and macro analysis.
  • Along with creating credit research, the candidate will assist in special reports and ad-hoc projects.
  • Interact with management and IR teams of companies covered. Attend conferences and company investor day as needed.
Required Skills, Experience, and Qualifications
  • The candidate should have 5+ years as either a credit or equity analyst.
  • Naturally curious and driven to figure out how to analyze complex situations and be tenacious in obtaining information.
  • Excellent understanding of financial statements: income statement, balance sheet and cash flows and the drive to thoroughly read the information supporting the financial statements.
  • A thorough understanding of debt and equity securities and the markets they trade in is required, including some knowledge of bankruptcy processes.
  • Valuation experience including waterfall, and DCF analysis is required.
  • Comprehensive knowledge of fixed income analytics (ie Z-spread, duration).
  • Fluency in Portuguese and/or Spanish (both strongly preferred).
  • Comprehensive knowledge of Excel and Word
  • Excellent writing skills, with the ability to build a thesis and reach a conclusion in a structured manner, are required.
  • Experience writing reports in English.
  • Ability to work in a team-based environment, with a sense of teamwork and cooperation
  • Ability to manage workflow under strict deadlines

About us

We’re a diverse group of visionary innovators who provide trading and workflow automation software, high-value analytics, and strategic consulting to corporations, central banks, financial institutions, and governments. Founded in 1999, we’ve achieved tremendous growth by bringing together some of the best and most successful financial technology companies in the world.

• Over 2,000 of the world’s leading corporations, including 50% of the Fortune 500 and 30% of the world’s central banks, trust ION solutions to manage their cash, in-house banking, commodity supply chain, trading and risk.

ION is a rapidly expanding and dynamic group with 13,000 employees and offices in more than 40 cities around the globe. Our ever-expanding global footprint, cutting edge products, and over 40,000 customers worldwide provide an unparalleled career experience for those who share our vision.

ION is committed to maintaining a supportive and inclusive environment for people with diverse backgrounds and experiences. Are you looking to work at the forefront of Machine Learning and AI? Would you be excited to apply Generative AI algorithms to solve real-world problems with significant impact? The Generative AI Innovation Center helps AWS customers implement Generative AI solutions and realize transformational business opportunities. This is a team of strategists, scientists, engineers, and architects working step-by-step with customers to build bespoke solutions that harness the power of generative AI.


The team helps customers imagine and scope the use cases that will create the greatest value for their businesses, define paths to navigate technical or business challenges, develop proof-of-concepts, and make plans for launching solutions at scale. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Qualifications

  • Strong understanding of distributed systems, microservices architecture, and containerization.
  • Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Experience in dealing with large data sets.
  • Basic knowledge about Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence applications.
  • Proficient in English language.
  • Understanding of data modeling and data warehousing concepts.

Additional Information

What do we offer you?

  • Permanent, full-time contract.
  • Smart Office Pack so that you can work comfortably from home.
  • Training and career development.
  • Benefits and perks such as private medical insurance, life insurance, lunch and travel cards as part of the flexible remuneration package.
  • Possibility to be part of a multicultural team and work on international projects.
  • Hybrid position, based in Málaga. Relocation is mandatory.

description:
As the nation’s leader in helping businesses efficiently connect with the top realtors in their market, The N2 Company produces high-quality monthly publications, targeted digital advertising and exclusive events. We are looking for an Advertising Manager for The N2 Company . Our magazines are mailed directly to the top-producing agents in each market and share personal stories that connect, elevate, and inspire.

Who we are looking for:

An ideal person for this opportunity is a professional, outgoing person who has an entrepreneurial mindset.

Though most of the day-to-day work for an Advertising Manager revolves around sales-related activity, it is far from a traditional sales role. Many of our Advertising Managers , known as Area Directors, do have prior sales experience, but our unique low-pressure sales approach combined with the other aspects of the opportunity mean our most successful people operate more dynamically as business owners.

Though some sales and business experience is a plus, we provide extensive training and a support system to help all Area Directors be as successful as possible.

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Meet with local business owners for a low-pressure consultative meeting to determine if a partnership with The N2 Company in their market is a mutual fit.
  • Develop a network within the real estate community through a proven model for engagement.
  • Plan events aimed at connecting top agents and preferred client partners using the N2 formula.
  • Meet with realtors to develop relationships and recommendations for potential partners.

What ideal candidates find most attractive:

  • Control Over Their Schedule – While our Advertising Managers have a strong work ethic and are motivated by a sense of purpose in their role, they can flex their hours to optimize their productivity and work-life balance.
  • Uncapped Potential – Though not every Advertising Manager is looking for the highest earning potential, most people take advantage of the commission structure that allows them to grow their income uncapped year after year.
  • Meaningful Opportunity – Our ideal candidates have many options when changing jobs, yet those most attracted to this role find a sense of purpose in helping local business owners grow their businesses – especially in a time when there's so much noise revolving around advertising and digital marketing. Our Area Directors help simplify things for our partners and stand behind our publications and digital offerings with confidence and integrity.

Our average commission paid to the top Area Directors with one publication was more than $352,400* during the fiscal year.

More about The N2 Company:

For 20 years, The N2 Company has created opportunities for our people to work with others they actually like, where they're inspired to grow financially, relationally, and spiritually. This people-first mindset has led to rapid growth – we earned a spot on the Inc. 5000 eight years in a row – and a company culture recognized by the likes of Entrepreneur, Fortune, Newsweek, and Glassdoor. We help businesses connect with their ideal clients through 800 custom publications – and more launching every month. N2's portfolio of award-winning brands includes Stroll, Greet, BeLocal, Uniquely You, Salute, and Hyport Digital.

The average yearly Commission earned for the top 10%, 11 publications (out of 105) in the Reporting Period was $326,770.00. Of this group, 4 (36%) earned a Commission payment that totaled the average or more, and 7 (64%) earned a Commission payment that totaled less than the average. The median Commission earned for this group was $305,523.00. The highest Commission earned was $536,121.00, and the lowest Commission earned was $219,782.00.

Your financial results may differ from those stated above. Important assumptions and qualifiers relating to this information can be found in Item 19 of our October 11, 2024 franchise disclosure document.

title: Grants Proposal Manager
description:
Grants Proposal Manager
Arlington VA (DC) – Onsite 3 days per week
Job Summary:
The Grants Proposal Manager will oversee the end-to-end process of preparing and submitting compliant grant applications to federal agencies (NIH, NSF, DOE, CDC, AHRQ) and major private foundations (e.g., Gates Foundation, Pew Charitable Trusts). This role collaborates closely with principal investigators and internal teams to ensure timely, accurate, and policy-compliant submissions using platforms like NIH ASSIST and Grants.gov. Responsibilities include managing proposal components, improving submission processes, maintaining internal documentation, and providing training on grant systems and requirements.
Responsibilities:
  • Grant Management – Manages the coordination and submission of moderately complex grant applications. Works with principal investigators, division staff, grants administrators, pricing analysts and administrative teams to compile technical, budgetary, and administrative components. Provides guidance to principal investigators on interpreting and meeting submission requirements and instructions. Ensures proposals are submitted in compliance with sponsor requirements and in a timely manner, with limited oversight.
  • Proposal Support Materials – Assists with customizing and updating biosketches, current and pending support documents, facilities descriptions, and other required grant attachments. Maintains internal templates, boilerplate and document libraries for use across submissions.
  • Grants Process Improvements – Supports the development, documentation, and maintenance of standard operating procedures, templates, and checklists for grant submissions. Contributes to continuous process improvement and documentation efforts.
  • Training and Professional Development – Participates in training and process development efforts for research teams and PDS staff on grant-related topics such as sponsor systems, updates to submission policies, and institutional processes. Attends professional development opportunities and stays up to date on changes within the various grant-making federal agencies to which our company applies.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration – Works closely with pricing analysts, grants administrators, research and analysis staff, division leadership, external affairs, and other teams to ensure seamless coordination of grant applications and post-submission requirements.
  • System and Recordkeeping – Ensures submission records and supporting documents are maintained in appropriate institutional systems, including CRM or grant management tools as applicable.
  • Technical Assistance – Provides guidance to proposal team members and research teams on sponsor systems such as NIH ASSIST, eRA Commons, and Grants.gov Workspace.

Required Qualifications:
  • 4+ years of experience managing the full lifecycle of grant submissions, particularly for federal agencies (NIH, NSF).
  • Proficiency with grant submission platforms such as NIH ASSIST, Grants.gov, and eRA Commons.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills for collaborating with diverse proposal teams.
  • Familiarity with various funding mechanisms (grants, contracts, cooperative agreements).

Preferred (Nice to Have):
  • Experience with enterprise CRM or grant management systems.
  • Understanding of federal acquisition regulations (FAR, DFAR) and contract pricing models (T&M, CPFF, FFP).
  • Knowledge of budget development and pricing strategies for grant proposals.
  • Experience supporting major private foundation submissions.
  • Prior experience delivering training or process improvement initiatives related to grant submissions.

TheGlobal DBA Engineer (DBA) role is responsible for the performance, integrity, security, and availability of databases within the organization. description:
A Zoetis valoriza e apoia a inclusão, prezando pela igualdade de oportunidades.

CIDADE: RONDONOPOLIS (MT)

SUMÁRIO DA POSIÇÃO

Responsável pelo planejamento, realização e acompanhamento das vendas aos canais de varejo e distribuição do seu setor de acordo com a política comercial, assim como pela identificação de oportunidades e implantações de ações de estímulo a vendas, visando explorar ao máximo o potencial do território e atingir os objetivos comerciais, financeiros e de marketing propostos.

RESPONSABILIDADES DO CARGO

  • Assegurar que os objetivos comerciais e financeiros da Zoetis sejam alcançados em seu território, incluindo objetivos de venda, mix, preço, penetração e de valorização de marca;

  • Implantar e gerenciar a Política Comercial em seu setor de vendas, assegurando a correta classificação e segmentação dos canais;

  • Liderar a construção e a execução do Plano Estratégico Conjunto com os canais, com objetivo de positivação das marcas e atingimento das metas de sell-out e de sell-in;

  • Elaborar o Planejamento de Vendas do setor com base nas cotas recebidas, juntamente com a equipe do setor;

  • Mapear, estabelecer, cultivar e gerenciar relacionamento com tomadores de decisão e influenciadores de cada canal de comercialização (Distribuidores, Atacadistas, Revendas e Cooperativas);

  • Monitorar constantemente o nível de estoque dos seus canais, tomando as ações necessárias;

  • Identificar oportunidades e promover ações, em parceria com os canais, buscando estimular o giro dos produtos;

  • Implementar as ações de Trade Marketing definidas pela BU nos canais da sua responsabilidade, monitorando os resultados;

  • Implementar e acompanhar ações de merchandising nos canais diretos, visando uma melhor apresentação, comunicação da mensagem do produto e maximização do retorno dos investimentos realizados;

  • Assegurar a capacitação e engajamento da força de vendas dos canais atendidos sobre produtos e campanhas Zoetis através de reuniões, treinamentos e vistas acompanhadas;

  • Realizar treinamentos técnico-comerciais da linha Zoetis para equipe de vendas dos canais, visando a oferta adequada dos produtos aos consumidores finais;

  • Registrar as interações com os canais na ferramenta CRM e atingir os objetivos estabelecidos.

  • Prospectar constantemente novos canais, com objetivo de ampliar/renovar carteira de cliente e explorar o potencial do território;

  • Implantar as estratégias de acesso ao mercado em seu setor, buscando ampliar a disponibilidade, penetração da linha de produtos da Zoetis, assim como o desenvolvimento de novos mercados;

  • Conhecer e monitorar constantemente o desempenho dos produtos/linhas Zoetis dentro dos canais e em relação aos concorrentes;

  • Monitorar e reportar as ações da concorrência nos canais disponíveis;

  • Acompanhar os pedidos, desde que são realizados até o seu pagamento, interagindo – quando necessário com as áreas internas;

  • Zelar pelo bom estado dos equipamentos da área sob sua responsabilidade;

  • Zelar pela confidencialidade das informações sob sua responsabilidade;

  • Cumprir as normas e regulamentos contidos no Código de Conduta da empresa.

RELAÇÕES ORGANIZACIONAIS

Gerente de Vendas, Coordenador de Demanda, Assistente Tecnico, Gerente de Produto, Efetividade de Vendas, Logistica, Serviços de Marketing, Administração de Vendas, Financeiro.

RECURSOS GERENCIADOS

Vendas aos canais do seu setor, orçamento de gastos.

SUPERVISÃO

Para esta posição não se reporta nenhum colaborador diretamente. No entanto, ele(a) lidera e influencia indiretamente um time multifuncional.

EDUCAÇÃO / EXPERIÊNCIA

Educação:

Preferencialmente gradução em Veterinária ou relacionado. --- Administração de empresas, Economia, Engenharia, Zootecnia, Agronomia

Idiomas:

Inglês intermediário;

Espanhol (desejável).

Experiência:

  • Mínimo de 7 anos de experiência em Vendas incluindo negociação, gestão de contas, gestão de canais e trade marketing;

  • Comprovada experiência no relacionamento com clientes, colegas e parceiros.

REQUISITOS DE HABILIDADES TÉCNICAS

  • Forte conhecimento da área de veterinária;

  • Habilidade na comunicação oral, escrita e interpessoal (incluindo palestras, apresentações, etc) e na liderança de pessoas (representante dos distribuidores);

  • Capacidade para trabalhar de forma independente e eficiente, influenciando distribuidores, supervisores e representantes de venda;

  • Habilidade para se relacionar com distribuidores, clientes e demais membros da equipe, promovendo as relações duradouras no espírito ganha-ganha;

  • Organização, planejamento e comprovada gestão eficiente do tempo, do território e de canais de acesso;

  • Domínio dos seguintes programas de informática: Excel, Word, PowerPoint e os sistemas de propriedade Zoetis, ou habilidade para aprender com rapidez;

  • Habilidade para aprender rapidamente informações técnicas e científicas, bem como de vendas;

  • Pró-atividade na realização de suas atividades;

  • Perfil alinhado aos objetivos, missão e visão da empresa, e com foco nos clientes.

REQUISITOS DA POSIÇÃO – ESPAÇO FISICO

Disponibilidade para viagens frenquentes.

Sobre nós

Nossa história começou em 2001, com um pequeno escritório de agentes autônomos de investimentos em Porto Alegre e hoje somos um grande ecossistema de serviços financeiros, mídia e educação.

Chegamos até aqui com a dedicação de equipes talentosas que tiveram garra, determinação, resiliência e, acima de tudo, ambição de fazer o impossível.

Nossos valores

  • Foco no cliente: Somos obstinados em superar as expectativas dos nossos clientes.
  • Sonho grande: Miramos no impossível, acreditamos que ele pode se tornar realidade, e chegamos lá juntos.
  • Mente aberta: Nossa abertura para o novo e nossa capacidade de adaptação são o que nos fazem evoluir e melhorar sempre.
  • Espírito empreendedor: Construímos o futuro com nossas próprias mãos com o mais alto nível de comprometimento e sentimento de dono.

Sobre a Oportunidade

Tem perfil comercial, busca transição de carreira e quer fazer parte de um time de alta performance?

Conheça o XP Future - Interior do Rio de Janeiro (Petrópolis, Teresópolis e Nova Friburgo) , uma iniciativa disruptiva para profissionais com alto skill comercial e que desejam se tornar assessores de investimentos.

Essa é uma oportunidade para profissionais que estão em busca de uma transição de carreira e possuem experiência comercial para migrarem para o mercado financeiro.

Na XP Inc. você terá todo o suporte para uma rápida integração e consolidação de seu novo escopo em assessoria, desenvolvendo e aprimorando habilidades de vendas, prospecção de clientes, aprofundamento nos produtos de investimentos e, principalmente, uma imersão no dia a dia do mercado financeiro. Além disso, o programa conta com uma esteira robusta de carreira para que você se torne um profissional comercial de sucesso na corretora, e tire a certificação CPA-20 para se tornar um assessor referência no mercado!

Se você já possui experiência comercial em outros segmentos e deseja fazer uma transição de carreira para o mercado financeiro, conheça os pré-requisitos para iniciar no XP Future logo abaixo!

O Que Procuramos

Pré-requisitos Essenciais:

  • Ter a nossa cultura;
  • Graduação superior completa ou estar cursando o último ano em período noturno;
  • Perfil comercial e relacional;
  • Experiência comercial (diferencial como Hunter - prospecção de novos negócios);
  • Curiosidade sobre o mundo dos investimentos;
  • Interesse por realizar uma transição de carreira;
  • Estar atuando em outros segmentos de mercado (Meios de pagamentos, adquirência, bebidas, fintechs, etc);
  • Não ser um Assessor de Investimentos ou Agente Autônomo (AAI).

Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento sobre produtos financeiros (RF, RV, fundos e outros);
  • CPA-20 ou CEA (Caso o candidato aprovado não tenha a certificação do CPA-20, fornecemos o curso de forma gratuita, em parceria com a Academia Rafael Toro).

Desafios e Impacto:

  • Atuação no segmento de Assessoria de Investimentos, sendo responsável por aconselhar e auxiliar a gestão de patrimônio dos clientes;
  • Elaboração de portfólio de investimentos em linha com o perfil e objetivo dos clientes;
  • Análise de alocações externas, elaboração de estudos comparativos exclusivos e identificando oportunidades;
  • Acompanhamento de tendências de mercado, se mantendo sempre informado sobre atualidades do cenário econômico;
  • Disciplina para manter uma alta frequência de contato com clientes de forma online e presencial.

Obs.: a contratação é CLT.

Essa vaga é destinada a um pool de rede de talentos a nível Brasil, então pode ser que o retorno demore um pouco a mais do que outras vagas da XP! Em paralelo, também estão abertas as vagas dos XDays XP Future (vagas que acontecerão processos seletivos presenciais na cidade divulgada) para você se aplicar! Essas oportunidades se encontram aqui: Oportunidades XP Inc.

  1. Triagem inicial : Análise do currículo para verificar a adequação às qualificações e requisitos da vaga.

  2. Testes gerais : Avaliação do alinhamento cultural com o teste da Mindsight e teste de raciocínio lógico da Predictive Index.

  3. Entrevista com a equipe de Recrutamento : Discussão sobre as expectativas em relação à vaga e aos objetivos profissionais.

  4. Entrevista com a liderança : Uma conversa para discutir sua visão e como você pode contribuir para a equipe e a empresa.

  5. Entrevista com Head Comercial : Conversa para discutir sobre o seu perfil e características necessárias para contribuir com a operação.

  6. Entrevista focada em cultura : Exploração dos valores e princípios da empresa para garantir um bom encaixe cultural.

  7. Oferta : Apresentação da proposta de trabalho, incluindo detalhes sobre remuneração e benefícios.

A Giesecke+Devrient é uma empresa global que oferece tecnologias de segurança, tanto no mundo físico como digital. Todos os dias, milhares de milhões de pessoas beneficiam-se das inovações da G+D nas suas vidas pessoais e empresariais. Com cerca de 12.600 funcionários em 33 países, desenvolvemos, fabricamos e distribuímos produtos e soluções para a proteção de processos de pagamento, identidades, conectividade e dados.

Tudo começou em 1852, quando começou a impressão de títulos em Leipzig. Hoje, nosso portfólio é tão diversificado quanto a vida móvel moderna. Como líder de mercado global, a G+D é o parceiro de confiança de 145 bancos centrais em todo o mundo e de todos os outros participantes do ciclo monetário.

Com base na nossa competência, criamos soluções inovadoras construindo o nosso portfólio de Gestão Avançada de Moeda – incluindo design de notas à prova de falsificação, papel de alta qualidade e recursos de segurança, produção de notas, processamento altamente eficiente de notas e fim de vida útil, bem como soluções para CBDC. title: XP Future 2025 | Interview Day Belém
description:
Sobre nós

Nossa história começou em 2001, com um pequeno escritório de agentes autônomos de investimentos em Porto Alegre e hoje somos um grande ecossistema de serviços financeiros, mídia e educação.

Chegamos até aqui com a dedicação de equipes talentosas que tiveram garra, determinação, resiliência e, acima de tudo, ambição de fazer o impossível.

Nossos valores

  • Foco no cliente: Somos obstinados em superar as expectativas dos nossos clientes.
  • Sonho grande: Miramos no impossível, acreditamos que ele pode se tornar realidade, e chegamos lá juntos.
  • Mente aberta: Nossa abertura para o novo e nossa capacidade de adaptação são o que nos fazem evoluir e melhorar sempre.
  • Espírito empreendedor: Construímos o futuro com nossas próprias mãos com o mais alto nível de comprometimento e sentimento de dono.

Interview Day Belém | Transição de Carreira

Tem perfil comercial, busca transição de carreira e quer fazer parte de um time de alta performance?

Conheça o XP Future , uma iniciativa disruptiva para profissionais com alto skill comercial e que desejam se tornar assessores de investimentos.

Essa é uma oportunidade para profissionais que estão em busca de uma transição de carreira e possuem experiência comercial para migrarem para o mercado financeiro.

Na XP Inc. você terá todo o suporte para uma rápida integração e consolidação de seu novo escopo em assessoria, desenvolvendo e aprimorando habilidades de vendas, prospecção de clientes, aprofundamento nos produtos de investimentos e, principalmente, uma imersão no dia a dia do mercado financeiro. Além disso, o programa conta com uma esteira robusta de carreira para que você se torne um profissional comercial de sucesso na corretora, e tire a certificação CPA-20 para se tornar um assessor referência no mercado!

Se você já possui experiência comercial em outros segmentos e deseja fazer uma transição de carreira para o mercado financeiro, conheça os pré-requisitos para iniciar no XP Future logo abaixo!

O Que Procuramos

Pré-requisitos Essenciais:

  • Ter a nossa cultura;
  • Graduação superior completa;
  • Perfil comercial e relacional;
  • Experiência comercial (diferencial como Hunter - prospecção de novos negócios);
  • Curiosidade sobre o mundo dos investimentos;
  • Interesse por realizar uma transição de carreira;
  • Conhecimento básico sobre produtos financeiros (RF, RV, fundos e outros);
  • Estar atuando em outros segmentos de mercado (Meios de pagamentos, adquirência, bebidas, fintechs, etc);
  • Não ser um Assessor de Investimentos ou Agente Autônomo (AAI).

Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento sobre produtos financeiros (RF, RV, fundos e outros);
  • CPA-20 ou CEA (Caso o candidato aprovado não tenha a certificação do CPA-20, fornecemos o curso de forma gratuita, em parceria com a Academia Rafael Toro).

Desafios e Impacto:

  • Atuação no segmento de Assessoria de Investimentos, sendo responsável por aconselhar e auxiliar a gestão de patrimônio dos clientes;
  • Elaboração de portfólio de investimentos em linha com o perfil e objetivo dos clientes;
  • Análise de alocações externas, elaboração de estudos comparativos exclusivos e identificando oportunidades;
  • Acompanhamento de tendências de mercado, se mantendo sempre informado sobre atualidades do cenário econômico;
  • Disciplina para manter uma alta frequência de contato com clientes de forma online e presencial.

Obs.: a contratação é CLT.

Etapas do Processo:

  1. Triagem inicial : Análise do currículo para verificar a adequação às qualificações e requisitos da vaga.

  2. Testes gerais : Avaliação do alinhamento cultural com o teste da Mindsight e teste de raciocínio lógico da Predictive Index.

  3. Entrevista com a equipe de Recrutamento : Discussão sobre as expectativas em relação à vaga e aos objetivos profissionais.

  4. Interview Day : Dinâmica focada nas habilidades específicas necessárias para a função.

  5. Entrevista com a liderança : Uma conversa para discutir sua visão e como você pode contribuir para a equipe e a empresa.

  6. Entrevista com Head Comercial : Conversa para discutir sobre o seu perfil e características necessárias para contribuir com a operação.

  7. Entrevista focada em cultura : Exploração dos valores e princípios da empresa para garantir um bom encaixe cultural.

  8. Oferta : Apresentação da proposta de trabalho, incluindo detalhes sobre remuneração e benefícios.

Por fim, abaixo segue o vídeo sobre o Fator XP! Para você se reconhecer cada vez mais no nosso propósito como empresa e cultura:

Benefícios que oferecemos:

  • Saúde e bem-estar: plano de saúde, plano odontológico, Gympass, Zenklub, VA, VR, New Value, seguro de vida.
  • Maternidade e Paternidade: auxílio creche para pais e mães, licença maternidade de 6 meses, licença paternidade de 20 dias.
  • Só na XP Inc.: assessoria de investimento e acesso a fundos de investimentos exclusivos.

Jornada de trabalho com flexibilidade:

O nosso modelo de trabalho varia de acordo com a função: presencial para frentes de negócio e híbrido para as demais equipes. É importante ressaltar que todos os colaboradores precisam morar na localidade da vaga (nossa sede está localizada na cidade de São Paulo e é onde temos o maior número de posições), já que temos atividades que exigem a presença física para promover a colaboração e os rituais da nossa cultura. Esses encontros são organizados de acordo com as orientações dos líderes e as particularidades de cada rotina, para que nossos colaboradores possam exercer suas jornadas de trabalho com liberdade e autonomia.

Main responsibilities

Conhecimentos em finanças, administração e vendas;

Habilidades em comunicação, negociação e atendimento ao cliente.

Procuramos uma pessoa que:

title: Medewerker huurzaken en debiteurenbeheer
description:
Ben jij een administratieve rots in de branding met oog voor detail, uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden en affiniteit met huurrecht en financiële administratie? Timon Wonen zoekt een gedreven Medewerker huurzaken en debiteurenbeheer om ons team te versterken!

Jouw werk doet ertoe!

Werken aan een goede basis waardoor kwetsbare kinderen, jongeren en gezinnen de zorg krijgen die zij verdienen. Dankzij jouw bijdrage hebben zij weer hoop op herstel en perspectief. Dat is waar je het voor doet. Als Medewerker huurzaken ben je samen met je collega's verantwoordelijk voor de administratie rondom de verhuur binnen Timon. Je hebt contact met woningcorporaties, huisvestingscoördinatoren, woninginspecteurs, cliënten en hulpverleners. Zo zorg je ervoor dat onze jongeren een dak boven hun hoofd hebben en houden. Kortom, jouw werk doet ertoe!

Wat ga je doen?

Als Medewerker huurzaken en debiteurenbeheer ben je verantwoordelijk voor het volledige proces rondom huurcontracten en huurdebiteuren. Je monitort, analyseert en stuurt op oplossingen, en ondersteunt zowel medewerkers als cliënten in het huurproces. Je signaleert verbetermogelijkheden en draagt bij aan een efficiënte huuradministratie.

Je werkzaamheden omvatten onder andere:

Opstellen en verwerken van huurcontracten en documenten: Je zorgt voor de juiste huurprijsbepaling, stelt contracten op en verwerkt huurmutaties en huuropzeggingen.

Beantwoorden van vragen: Je biedt ondersteuning bij vragen over huurverhogingen, servicekosten en afrekeningen, en communiceert helder met huurders, collega’s en externe partijen.

Administratieve verwerking bij vastgoedbeheer: Je verzorgt de administratieve afhandeling bij het verwerven en afstoten van vastgoed en houdt iedereen binnen de organisatie op de hoogte van nieuwe locaties.

Beheren van huurbetalingen: Je verwerkt huurbetalingen, regelt automatische incasso’s, en draagt zorg voor tijdige betalingen aan wooncorporaties.

Debiteurenbeheer:

Je monitort of huurders tijdig betalen en onderneemt stappen bij achterstallige betalingen. Je treft betalingsregelingen en escaleert naar de juiste personen wanneer de huurschuld toeneemt.

Contact onderhouden met externe partijen: Je werkt samen met bewindvoerders en schuldsaneringsinstellingen om betalingsproblemen tijdig op te lossen.

Verwerken van borgbetalingen en eindinspecties: Je zorgt voor correcte verwerking van borgen en een nette afhandeling na beëindiging van huurcontracten.

Wat breng je mee?

  • Als Medewerker huurzaken en debiteurenbeheer maak je het onderscheid door jouw combinatie van consciëntieuze werkhouding; analytisch inzicht, nauwkeurigheid en uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden. Je kunt gemakkelijk schakelen tussen administratieve taken en mensgericht contact. Je hecht waarde aan structuur, nauwkeurigheid, logica en het leveren van kwalitatief hoogstaand werk. Daarnaast beschik je over:
  • MBO 4 werk- en denkniveau.
  • Affiniteit met huurrecht en ervaring met financiële administratie.
  • Sterke softskills: Je bent communicatief vaardig, kunt goed luisteren en weet met tact en empathie lastige gesprekken te voeren.
  • Vaardigheid in Axxerion, AFAS en Excel.
  • Minimaal drie jaar relevante werkervaring.
  • Een zelfstandige werkhouding: Je pakt taken proactief op en werkt nauwkeurig.
  • Ervaring in de sociale verhuur of kennis van huurrecht (pré).
  • Ervaring met FMIS-systemen: Aantoonbare ervaring met Spacewell Axxerion of een vergelijkbaar systeem is een pré.

Wat bieden wij?


Een functie voor 24 uur.

Je komt te werken binnen een klein, gezellig team. Het team huurzaken bestaat uit vier medewerkers en valt onder Timon Wonen. Op basis van een 36-urige werkweek kun je rekenen op:

Een bruto maandsalaris volgens de cao Jeugdzorg schaal 6 vanaf € 2618,60 tot € 3722,88 afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring.

Een jaarcontract. Functioneer je goed? Dan zetten we deze om in een vast dienstverband.

25 vakantiedagen.

8% vakantiegeld en een eindejaarsuitkering van 8,3% van je bruto jaarsalaris.

Reiskostenvergoeding of thuiswerkvergoeding.

Voor indiensttreding is het screeningsbeleid van Timon van toepassing. Deze is altijd opvraagbaar en wordt toegelicht in het arbeidsvoorwaardengesprek.

Wij zijn Timon

Je christelijke geloof verbinden met je professionele inzet? Dat kan bij Timon! Bij ons ben je er voor kinderen, jongeren en ouders. En ons team is er voor jóu. Iedereen kan een beroep op ons doen, ongeacht achtergrond en levensovertuiging. Met ruim 700 bevlogen medewerkers werken we in een groot deel van Nederland. We denken in kansen en zetten graag een stapje extra.

Jij @ Timon?

Denk jij dat Timon de organisatie is die bij je past? Solliciteer dan op de vacature voor Medewerker huurzaken en debiteurenbeheer. Heb je inhoudelijke vragen? Neem dan contact op met Eline Roodnat (Teammanager) via . Heb je vragen over de procedure? Neem dan contact op met onze recruiter.

We kijken uit naar je reactie!

Join to apply for the Engineering Manager, Data role at DoorDash

About The Team
DoorDash is a data driven organization and relies on timely, accurate and reliable data to drive many business and product decisions. Data is at the foundation of DoorDash success. The Data Engineering team builds database solutions for various use cases including reporting, product analytics, marketing optimization and financial reporting. About The Team
DoorDash is a data driven organization and relies on timely, accurate and reliable data to drive many business and product decisions. Data is at the foundation of DoorDash success. The Data Engineering team builds database solutions for various use cases including reporting, product analytics, marketing optimization and financial reporting. By implementing data structures and data warehouse architecture, this team serves as the foundation for decision-making at DoorDash. The focus extends to enhancing the developer experience by creating tools that support the organization's high-velocity demands.
To lead the growing team of Data engineers we are looking for managers who are passionate about Data and are thought leaders in coaching, guiding and leading teams to make Data a winning edge for DoorDash.
About The Role
DoorDash is looking for a Data Engineering Manager to guide the development of enterprise-scale data solutions. This manager will also act as a technical expert on all things related to data architecture to empower the greater community of data engineers, data scientists, and DoorDash partners. Your focus extends to fostering an engineering culture of excellence, empowering engineers to deliver reliable, flexible solutions at scale. Additionally, you'll play a pivotal role in building and nurturing a top-performing team, driving innovation and success in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • You are a people leader. You thrive in hiring, building, growing and nurturing impactful business focused data teams
  • You are a technology leader. You drive the technical and strategic vision for the embedded pods and foundational enablers to meet current and future needs for scale and interoperability
  • You strive for continuous improvement of data architecture and development process
  • You think of quick wins while planning for long term strategy and engineering excellence. You are excited about breaking down large systems into easy to use data assets and reusable components
  • You are excited about cross collaboration with stakeholders, external partners and peer data leaders
  • You are a planner and executioner. You know the tools to plan for short term and long term team and stakeholder success
  • You think of reliability and quality as must have
We’re excited about you because you have…
  • B.S., M.S., or PhD. in Computer Science or equivalent
  • 10+ years of experience working in data engineering, data platform or a related domain
  • 2+ years of hands-on management experience
  • Exceptional communication and leadership skills, experience hiring and growing teams with a proven ability to operate in a fast moving environment
  • Experienced with performance management, coaching, mentoring and growing teams
  • Familiar with programming languages Python/Kotlin and SQL
  • Prior experience with Snowflake/Databricks/Spark/Trino/Pinot
  • Prior experience with AWS ecosystem and large scale batch/real time ETL orchestration using Airflow, Kafka, Spark Streaming,etc.
  • Familiarity with various data lake file formats such as Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg, Glue Catalog, S3,etc
  • Experience with these specific technologies is not required but helpful
  • Building systems directly powering online applications
  • Exposure to various databases such as CockroachDB, Cassandra, and PostgreSQL
  • Proficient in system design and with a strong understanding and application of AI solutions in data space

title: Intensief Ambulant Gezinsbehandelaar Mevis en Rotterdam
description:
Vind je het belangrijk dat ieder kind thuis moet kunnen opgroeien? En draag je daar graag aan bij als zorgprofessional? Wil jij werken bij een organisatie in opbouw? Wil jij een bijdrage leveren aan het toekomstbestendig organiseren van ondersteuning en hulp aan jeugdigen en gezinnen? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou. Is deze vacature op het lijf geschreven maar heb je niet de opleiding tot intensief ambulant gezinsbehandelaar gedaan, dan betalen we graag je opleiding IAG.

Het team van Mevis willen we versterken met een aantal Intensief ambulant gezinsbehandelaars.

Mevis is een coöperatie van vijf zorgorganisaties, dat in 2023 is opgezet: Timon, MEE Rotterdam-Rijnmond, Yulius, ASVZ en Prokino Zorg en de partner voor de jeugdhulp in de gemeenten Maassluis, Vlaardingen en Schiedam. Mevis biedt jeugdhulp door deze dicht bij het kind en gezin – en zoveel mogelijk in het dagelijkse leven – te organiseren.

Geduld, doorzettingsvermogen en stáán voor het kind

Kinderen zijn gewoonlijk het best af bij hun eigen ouders. Sommige thuissituaties zijn complex. Ouders en kind die elkaar niet begrijpen, bijvoorbeeld vanwege een diagnose. Het kind dat zich afzet. Ouders die niet consequent zijn of té streng zijn en weinig liefde geven. Of zelf een verleden hebben. Als Intensief ambulant gezinsbehandelaar ondersteun je ouders in de zorg voor en opvoeding van hun kind. Dat vraagt om geduld én doorzettingsvermogen. Om empathisch vermogen en om stáán voor het kind.

Jouw werk doet ertoe

Als Intensief ambulant gezinsbehandelaar ben je er vooral voor de ouders, in het belang van het kind. Je brengt de situatie in kaart en stelt samen doelen. Je voert gesprekken met de ouders, het kind en het hele gezin. Samen werk je ernaar toe dat ze weer samen verder kunnen: de ouders en het kind. Dat is niet altijd een soepel traject. Het vraagt dus wel iets van jou als Intensief ambulant gezinsbehandelaar. Het uiteindelijke doel? Een fijne en veilige opgroeisituatie voor het kind. Daarnaast werkt je bij Mevis in het multidisciplinaire plusteam waarbij je meedenkt aan beleid en visie en consulteert aan en actief meegaat met wijkteams naar gezinnen. Kortom, jouw werk doet ertoe.

Dit ga je doen

  • Je ondersteunt ouders en kinderen in complexe thuis situaties.
  • Je stelt samen doelen op, legt die vast en gaat daarmee aan de slag.
  • Je houdt zelfstandig gesprekken en bepaalt wat nodig is.
  • Je bent een klankbord voor ouders en biedt handvatten.
  • Je zorgt dat iedereen zich gehoord en gezien voelt.
  • Je houdt de veiligheid en de ontwikkelingsmogelijkheden van het kind in de gaten.
  • Je werkt zelfstandig en overlegt met collega’s en de gedragswetenschapper.
  • Je werkt samen met het plusteam van Mevis.

Het team waarin je komt te werken is een multidisciplinair team met collega's die elkaar opzoeken, elkaar helpen, ervoor zorgen dat ze van elkaar leren en lol hebben in hun werk. Je werkt zelfstandig maar kan altijd terugvallen op een leuk team van professionals.

Dit vragen we van je

  • Een relevant hbo-diploma (bijvoorbeeld Social Work of Pedagogiek).
  • Een geldige SKJ-registratie.
  • Ervaring in de jeugdhulpverlening.
  • Kennis van therapeutische principes en systeemgerichte interventies.
  • Rijbewijs B en een auto.

Dit bieden wij

Op basis van een 36-urige werkweek kun je rekenen op:

  • Een bruto maandsalaris volgens de cao Jeugdzorg schaal 9, vanaf € 3.042,75 tot € 4.544,51, afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring.
  • Een jaarcontract. Functioneer je goed? Dan zetten we dit contract om in een vast dienstverband.
  • 25 vakantiedagen, 8% vakantiegeld en reiskostenvergoeding.
  • Een eindejaarsuitkering van 8,3% van je bruto jaarsalaris.
  • Een eigen coach die jou helpt met je persoonlijke doelstellingen en ontwikkeling.

Wij zijn Timon

Je christelijke geloof verbinden met je professionele inzet? Dat kan bij Timon! Bij ons ben je er voor kinderen, jongeren en ouders. En ons team is er voor jóu. Iedereen kan een beroep op ons doen, ongeacht achtergrond en levensovertuiging. Met ruim 750 bevlogen medewerkers werken we in een groot deel van Nederland. Timon innoveert en groeit. We denken in kansen en zetten graag een stapje extra.

Binnen Timon zijn er volop mogelijkheden om je verder te specialiseren . Bijvoorbeeld binnen een van de zorgconcepten die we bieden. Zoals Ouderschap na Scheiding, Kinderen uit de Knel, intensieve ambulante gezinsbegeleiding (IAG) en Ambulante spoedhulp.

Jij @ Timon?

Herken je jezelf in deze vacature en denk jij dat Timon de organisatie is die bij je past? Dan zien we je sollicitatie graag tegemoet.

Wil je een dag meelopen om kennis te maken met het team en de werkzaamheden, dan is dat mogelijk. Heb je nog vragen of wil je liever eerst wat meer informatie? Dan kan je contact opnemen met onze recruiter

description:
Jij vind het belangrijk dat ieder kind thuis moet kunnen opgroeien. En je draagt daar graag aan bij als zorgprofessional. Jij levert een bijdrage aan het toekomstbestendig organiseren van ondersteuning en hulp aan jeugdigen en gezinnen. Je gaat werken bij een samenwerking in opbouw. Is deze vacature je op het lijf geschreven maar je bent nog geen MDFT-therapeut, dan betalen we graag je opleiding MDFT-therapeut.

Het team van Mevis willen we versterken met een aantal MDFT-therapeuten. Mevis is een coöperatie van vijf zorgorganisaties, dat in 2023 is opgezet: Timon, MEE Rotterdam-Rijnmond, Yulius, ASVZ en de partner voor de jeugdhulp in de gemeenten Maassluis, Vlaardingen en Schiedam. Mevis biedt jeugdhulp door deze dicht bij het kind en gezin – en zoveel mogelijk in het dagelijkse leven – te organiseren.

Als MDFT-therapeut maak je deel uit van een enthousiast en deskundig team dat specialistische jeugdzorg biedt in de regio Rotterdam Rijnmond. Vanuit het team wordt gewerkt met verschillende zorgconcepten zoals IAG, MDFT, Ouderschap na Scheiding, Verbindend Gezag en SoS (Sigans of Safety). In nauwe samenwerking met ketenpartners in de regio. Leren en ontwikkelen als team is daarbij vanzelfsprekend.

Hoopvol, vasthoudend en stimulerend

In de kern kunnen ouder en kind niet zonder elkaar. Toch kan de relatie sterk verstoord raken, met ernstige en complexe gedragsproblemen als gevolg. Als MDFT-therapeut behandel je ouders en jongeren naar herstel van de relatie. Daarbij betrek je ook het netwerk, zoals grootouders, vriend en school. Samen met ouder en jongere achterhaal je welke escalatiepatronen zijn ontstaan en wat de achterliggende oorzaken zijn. Met jouw sturende aanpak en hoopvolle en vasthoudende instelling stimuleer je de ouder en de jongere die patronen zélf te doorbreken.

Jouw werk doet ertoe

Als MDFT-therapeut ben je meerzijdig partijdig: je bent er voor de jongere en de ouder. En je leert hen om onbevooroordeeld te luisteren naar elkaar. Je deinst niet terug voor een pittige confrontatie. In een intensief en doelgericht traject werk je ernaartoe dat ouder en jongere elkaar weer vinden. Ook voorkom je uithuisplaatsingen. Dat ze positieve ervaringen opdoen en samen verder kunnen. En dat de jongere opgroeit in een veilige omgeving, met positief effect op het gedrag. Kortom, jouw werk doet ertoe.

Dit ga je doen

  • Je ondersteunt ouders en kinderen in complexe thuissituaties.
  • Je stelt samen doelen op, legt die vast en gaat daarmee aan de slag.
  • Je houdt zelfstandig gesprekken en bepaalt wat nodig is.
  • Je bent een klankbord voor ouders en biedt handvatten.
  • Je zorgt dat iedereen zich gehoord en gezien voelt.
  • Je houdt de veiligheid en de ontwikkelingsmogelijkheden van het kind in de gaten.
  • Je werkt nauw samen met je collega-therapeuten, supervisor en gedragswetenschapper.
  • Je werkt mee in het plusteam van Mevis.
  • Je voert therapeutische sessies uit met het gezin.
  • Je stelt een plan van aanpak op met het gezin.
  • Je motiveert tot en het werken aan realisatie van verandering in het gezin.
  • Je voert gesprekken middels de MDFT-methodiek met betrokken partijen.

Dit vragen we van je

  • Een relevant hbo-diploma (bijvoorbeeld Social Work of Pedagogiek).
  • Een geldige SKJ-registratie.
  • Ervaring in de jeugdhulpverlening.
  • Kennis van therapeutische principes en systeemgerichte interventies.
  • Rijbewijs B en een auto.

Dit bieden wij

Als MDFT-therapeut kun je op basis van een 36-urige werkweek rekenen op:

  • Een bruto maandsalaris volgens de cao Jeugdzorg, schaal 10, vanaf € 3.472,90 tot € 5.217,35, afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring.
  • Een jaarcontract. Functioneer je goed? Dan zetten we dit contract om in een vast dienstverband.
  • 25 vakantiedagen, 8% vakantiegeld en reiskostenvergoeding.
  • Een eindejaarsuitkering van 8,3% van je bruto jaarsalaris.
  • Een eigen coach die jou helpt met je persoonlijke doelstellingen en ontwikkeling.
  • Ben je nog geen MDFT-therapeut, maar wil je wel reageren? Dat kan! Vanuit Timon kan je de opleiding tot MDFT-therapeut volgen. Deze start elk jaar in februari en oktober en duurt 9 maanden. Zodra jouw studie begint, werk je als MDFT-therapeut in opleiding. Je krijgt een bruto maandsalaris volgens de cao Jeugdzorg in schaal 9 van € 3.191,69 tot € 4.766,96, afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring.

Binnen Timon zijn er volop mogelijkheden om je verder te specialiseren. Bijvoorbeeld binnen een van de zorgconcepten die we bieden. Zoals Ouderschap na Scheiding, Kinderen uit de Knel, intensieve ambulante gezinsbegeleiding (IAG) en Ambulante spoedhulp.

Wij zijn Timon

Je christelijke geloof verbinden met je professionele inzet? Dat kan bij Timon! Bij ons ben je er voor kinderen, jongeren en ouders. En ons team is er voor jóu. Iedereen kan een beroep op ons doen, ongeacht achtergrond en levensovertuiging. Met ruim 800 bevlogen medewerkers werken we in een groot deel van Nederland. Timon innoveert en groeit. We denken in kansen en zetten graag een stapje extra.

Jij @ Timon?

Herken je jezelf in deze vacature en denk jij dat Timon de organisatie is die bij je past? Dan zien we je sollicitatie graag tegemoet.

Heb je inhoudelijke vragen over de functie dan kan je contact opnemen met José van Andel op . Wil je een dag meelopen om kennis te maken met het team en de werkzaamheden, dan is dat mogelijk.

title: XP Future | Transição de Carreira | São Paulo
description:
Sobre nós

Nossa história começou em 2001, com um pequeno escritório de agentes autônomos de investimentos em Porto Alegre e hoje somos um grande ecossistema de serviços financeiros, mídia e educação.

Chegamos até aqui com a dedicação de equipes talentosas que tiveram garra, determinação, resiliência e, acima de tudo, ambição de fazer o impossível.

Nossos valores

  • Foco no cliente: Somos obstinados em superar as expectativas dos nossos clientes.
  • Sonho grande: Miramos no impossível, acreditamos que ele pode se tornar realidade, e chegamos lá juntos.
  • Mente aberta: Nossa abertura para o novo e nossa capacidade de adaptação são o que nos fazem evoluir e melhorar sempre.
  • Espírito empreendedor: Construímos o futuro com nossas próprias mãos com o mais alto nível de comprometimento e sentimento de dono.

Sobre a Oportunidade

Tem perfil comercial, busca transição de carreira e quer fazer parte de um time de alta performance?

Conheça o XP Future - São Paulo , uma iniciativa disruptiva para profissionais com alto skill comercial e que desejam se tornar assessores de investimentos.

Essa é uma oportunidade para profissionais estão em busca de uma transição de carreira e possuem experiência comercial para migrarem para o mercado financeiro.

Na XP Inc. você terá todo o suporte para uma rápida integração e consolidação de seu novo escopo em assessoria, desenvolvendo e aprimorando habilidades de vendas, prospecção de clientes, aprofundamento nos produtos de investimentos e, principalmente, uma imersão no dia a dia do mercado financeiro. Além disso, o programa conta com uma esteira robusta de carreira para que você se torne um profissional comercial de sucesso na corretora, e tire a certificação CPA-20 para se tornar um assessor referência no mercado!

Se você já possui experiência comercial em outros segmentos e deseja fazer uma transição de carreira para o mercado financeiro, conheça os pré-requisitos para iniciar no XP Future logo abaixo!

O Que Procuramos

Pré-requisitos Essenciais:

  • Ter a nossa cultura;
  • Graduação superior completa ou estar cursando o último ano em período noturno;
  • Disponibilidade de trabalhar presencialmente em São Paulo;
  • Perfil comercial e relacional;
  • Experiência comercial (diferencial como Hunter - prospecção de novos negócios);
  • Curiosidade sobre o mundo dos investimentos;
  • Interesse por realizar uma transição de carreira;
  • Estar atuando em outros segmentos de mercado (Meios de pagamentos, adquirência, bebidas, fintechs, etc);
  • Não ser um Assessor de Investimentos ou Agente Autônomo (AAI).

Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento sobre produtos financeiros (RF, RV, fundos e outros);
  • CPA-20 ou CEA (Caso o candidato aprovado não tenha a certificação do CPA-20, fornecemos o curso de forma gratuita, em parceria com a Academia Rafael Toro)

Desafios e Impacto:

  • Atuação no segmento de Assessoria de Investimentos, sendo responsável por aconselhar e auxiliar a gestão de patrimônio dos clientes;
  • Elaboração de portfólio de investimentos em linha com o perfil e objetivo dos clientes;
  • Análise de alocações externas, elaboração de estudos comparativos exclusivos e identificando oportunidades;
  • Acompanhamento de tendências de mercado, se mantendo sempre informado sobre atualidades do cenário econômico;
  • Disciplina para manter uma alta frequência de contato com clientes de forma online e presencial.

*Obs.: a contratação é CLT.

Essa vaga é destinada a um pool de rede de talentos a nível Brasil, então pode ser que o retorno demore um pouco a mais do que outras vagas da XP! Em paralelo, também estão abertas as vagas dos XDays XP Future (vagas que acontecerão processos seletivos presenciais na cidade divulgada) para você se aplicar! Essas oportunidades se encontram aqui: Oportunidades XP Inc. ou

Etapas do Processo:

  1. Triagem inicial : Análise do currículo para verificar a adequação às qualificações e requisitos da vaga.

  2. Testes gerais : Avaliação do alinhamento cultural com o teste da Mindsight e teste de raciocínio lógico da Predictive Index.

  3. Entrevista com a equipe de Recrutamento : Discussão sobre as expectativas em relação à vaga e aos objetivos profissionais.

  4. Entrevista com a liderança : Uma conversa para discutir sua visão e como você pode contribuir para a equipe e a empresa.

  5. Entrevista com Head Comercial : Conversa para discutir sobre o seu perfil e características necessárias para contribuir com a operação.

  6. Entrevista focada em cultura : Exploração dos valores e princípios da empresa para garantir um bom encaixe cultural.

  7. Oferta : Apresentação da proposta de trabalho, incluindo detalhes sobre remuneração e benefícios.

Por fim, abaixo segue o vídeo sobre o Fator XP! Para você se reconhecer cada vez mais no nosso propósito como empresa e cultura:

Benefícios que oferecemos:

  • Saúde e bem-estar: plano de saúde, plano odontológico, Gympass, Zenklub, VA, VR, New Value, seguro de vida.
  • Maternidade e Paternidade: auxílio creche para pais e mães, licença maternidade de 6 meses, licença paternidade de 20 dias.
  • Só na XP Inc.: assessoria de investimento e acesso a fundos de investimentos exclusivos.

Jornada de trabalho com flexibilidade:

O nosso modelo de trabalho varia de acordo com a função: presencial para frentes de negócio e híbrido para as demais equipes. É importante ressaltar que todos os colaboradores precisam morar na localidade da vaga (nossa sede está localizada na cidade de São Paulo e é onde temos o maior número de posições), já que temos atividades que exigem a presença física para promover a colaboração e os rituais da nossa cultura. Esses encontros são organizados de acordo com as orientações dos líderes e as particularidades de cada rotina, para que nossos colaboradores possam exercer suas jornadas de trabalho com liberdade e autonomia.

From the beginning of our journey, we have an important mission: to give access . And this is not just about our products and services, but it goes through everything we are and do. We believe that it is only possible to innovate with diversity, so we cherish differences in gender, race, nationality, disability, sexual orientation, religion and age. Plurality is what makes our Big Dream possible.

We are called ebankers and we are changing the way people buy, connect, and live globally. Let's make history together?

You will work in a team of experienced developers and be responsible for maintaining a platform that processes millions of transactional requests every day. We cultivate an engineering culture that values and promotes sustainable quality, continuous delivery, high availability, quick feedback, and meritocracy.

As an EBANX leader you will be responsible for:

  • Managing a highly qualified and technical team;
  • Contribute and collaborate with the product areas and the development engineering team;
  • Have fun doing the management of technical teams and enabling the delivery of relevant products with global impact;
  • Create and send weekly reports on the progress of the team's activities to stakeholders;
  • Doing thorough code-reviews and help your teammates with complex designs and architectural decisions;
  • Testing and following your code to production continuously;
  • Working on strategic projects for EBANX;
  • Evolving and deciding the future of our payments platform;
  • A system of high availability (+ 99.9%) and with high throughput (100+ TPS), written in PHP, and MySQL (yes, it is possible :smile:). Don't know PHP? No problems, the important thing is to master the basics!
  • Mentoring and developing new talents;

What is indispensable for the job?

  • Proven experience of at least 5 years designing, implementing, and deploying software solutions to production;
  • Proven experience of at least 2 years leading a team of software engineers;
  • Interest in subjects such as data structures, concurrency, persistence, and distributed systems;
  • Expertise in git or any other collaborative version control system;
  • A vision for software quality, the evolution of systems, decomposition of problems and abstractions;
  • A great ability to learn new practices, technologies, programming languages and absorbing engineering culture;
  • Advanced English (read, write and speak);

What would we love to see?

  • Passion for software, you go to sleep and wake up thinking about how to make that part of the system more elegant or efficient;
  • Fluent English, we have customers from all around the world and it is commonplace for us to speak and write English when helping, supporting, and writing specifications with them;
  • Software development expertise in any complementary area to our core business, such as data warehouses, specialized development platforms, infrastructure automation, services provisioning, real-time systems, fault-tolerant systems, and mission-critical systems;
  • Experience with deploying to and monitoring a cloud infrastructure especially AWS.
  • Experience with computer networks, latency, package loss, routing optimization, monitoring, and problem-solving;
  • Full knowledge of SQL and relational databases;
  • Test-driven development: you don't even remember how to code without a very extensive test coverage; You often write the tests first and then the code.
  • Expertise in at least one functional or logic programming language -- besides SQL ;)
  • Comfortable with challenges of concurrency problems and has already worked in distributed and asynchronous systems;
  • Knowledge of data replication and conciliation;

What are we going to offer so you can do an amazing job?

  • Sustainable work pace: 40 hours a week of an accelerated but not frenetic rhythm - no marathons or sleepless nights; The focus is on working smarter.
  • The best tools money can buy so you can be productive in your work; (Macbook, Jetbrains licenses, Slack, Github, TravisCI, NewRelic, DataDog, ElasticSearch, Kibana, Tableau amongst others)
  • Deep and fast code reviews for any of your pull requests - You will also do a lot of them :)
  • Constant discussions about our practices and systems, everybody that wants to speak out is always heard and we are always open to new ideas, practices, and tools;
  • You will be free to dedicate part of your time to improve our systems and implement quality features that make us more efficient or less error-prone;
  • Frequent, fair, and transparent performance evaluations - all developers are evaluated with the same system and have access to the same career development opportunities;

EBANX offers:

  • A challenging environment, with opportunities to grow;
  • Casual office and flexible dress code;
  • Spanish, English and Portuguese classes;
  • WAVES - Program of goals and results (variable compensation);
  • EBANX Play - Wellness (Gympass, e-Sports, SESC );
  • Semi flexible hours (8 hours a day - Monday to Friday);
  • EBANX Skills: budget for workshops and courses;
  • EBANX Flexible: monthly Day Off from February to November, birthday Day Off and Rest up Month - one month of paid leave every three years of work anniversary.
  • EBANX Family: Daycare assistance, extended leave for caregivers and support program for children and pregnant women;
  • EBANX Health: Health and Dental Insurance, with subsidy for dependents, and medicine subsidy for ebankers;
  • Life Insurance: Life Insurance 100% paid by EBANX
  • Hello ebanker: psychology, finance and legal orientation.
  • Blue Club: Exclusive discount for ebankers in bakeries, restaurants, courses, electronics store and more!

title: Engineering Manager, Payments
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

You're an original. So are we.

We're a company of people who like to forge our own path. We invented the blue jean in 1873, and we reinvented khaki pants in 1986. We pioneered labor and environmental guidelines in manufacturing. And we work to build sustainability into everything we do. Our brands stand for freedom and self-expression around the world.

Where we lead, others follow. For more than 160 years, we've used the strength of our brands to lead with our values and make an outsized impact on the world. We employ more than 15,000 people globally to support our great brands: Levi's, Dockers, Denizen, Signature by Levi Strauss & Co. and Beyond Yoga.

As an Engineering Manager, you will lead the Payments domain in our technology organization. This role is critical to ensuring secure, scalable, and efficient payment processing across our global e-commerce and retail ecosystem. You will be responsible for managing a high-performing engineering team that builds and operates payment APIs and services supporting credit cards, gift cards, Buy Now Pay Later (BNPL), fraud detection, reconciliation, and in-store payment integrations.

You will drive technical excellence, architecture, and execution in alignment with our domain-driven design and direct-to-consumer strategy. As an engineering leader, you will collaborate with product management, security, store teams, mobile app team, website teams, and external payment providers to deliver robust, compliant, and scalable payment solutions . You will lead a highly skilled team of software engineers in a “you build it, you run it” environment. Your primary responsibility will be to drive your team toward successful and efficient delivery of high-quality software, while fostering a culture of ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement. You’ll ensure the team is aligned with company goals, adheres to best engineering practices, and upholds robust DevOps principles, including designing, building, testing, deploying, and monitoring the applications and services they create.

About the Job

  • Lead and Mentor : Provide technical guidance, career development support, and mentorship to team members, helping them to grow in both technical and soft skills.

  • Team Leadership & Culture : Promote a culture of accountability, collaboration, and trust where engineers feel ownership of their work and are empowered to take initiative.

  • Strategic Planning : Work closely with Product Management, UX, and other stakeholders to define and deliver on a roadmap aligned with company objectives and customer needs.

  • Technical Execution : Ensure that technical designs, code, and testing meet high standards. Facilitate architectural and design discussions to guarantee scalable and resilient solutions.

  • Process Management : Improve software development processes, implementing best practices for CI/CD, code reviews, automated testing, and deployment to streamline development and deployment cycles.

  • Ownership of Operations : Champion a DevOps mindset, where the team not only builds but also runs and monitors their own applications in production, ensuring reliability, availability, and performance.

  • Problem Solving : Facilitate solutions to complex technical problems, proactively identifying bottlenecks, risks, and quality concerns, and implementing measures to address them.

  • Performance Monitoring : Track and report on team performance, KPIs, and quality metrics, ensuring a high level of transparency and focus on improvement areas. Prioritize talent development and help with hiring new talent and grow engineers that are already at Levi Strauss & Co.

  • Experience Working with Global Companies: Work with teams around the world and support your global-capable platform.

About You

  • 10+ years of experience in product and/or platform engineering role, with tangible accomplishments in ecommerce or similar customer-facing digital experiences and APIs.

  • Proven Experience : Minimum 7 years of engineering experience, including hands-on software development and at least 2 years in a management or technical leadership role.

  • Technical Skills : Proficiency in any of Java, Node.js, TypeScript, GoLang, with a deep understanding of modern software engineering and DevOps practices. Deep knowledge of RESTful APIs, event-driven architecture, and cloud-native services.

  • Strong Leadership : Track record of managing and motivating a team, fostering a productive, collaborative, and high-accountability environment.

  • Process Improvement : Demonstrated ability to identify process inefficiencies and implement improvements that accelerate development without compromising quality.

  • Problem Solving & Decision Making : Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to make informed decisions and prioritize effectively.

  • Stakeholder Management : Experience working with cross-functional teams, especially Product and UX, to ensure cohesive product development and delivery.

  • Operational Excellence : Commitment to maintaining high standards for operational reliability, availability, and scalability, as well as familiarity with monitoring and alerting tools.

  • Hands-on experience with payment gateways, acquiring banks, fraud prevention, and reconciliation .

  • Understanding of PCI compliance, security best practices, and fraud prevention strategies.

  • Familiarity with payment orchestration, tokenization, chargebacks, and settlement processes.

LOCATION : Mexico, D.F., Mexico

FULL TIME/PART TIME : Full time

Do you enjoy a fast-paced environment? Do you like seeing your work create real-time impact, being part of a rocket ship from the very beginning? Let’s do the unimaginable - let’s make ads clean and cool again, with AI and modern technology.

O que buscamos:

Profissional que atue como Especialista RabbitMQ. Irá atuar na modalidade Remoto.

Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Sólido conhecimento de RabbitMQ: funcionamento interno, tuning, políticas de mirror/queue, quorum queues, federation, shovel;
  • Experiência com infraestrutura como código (IaC) e automação de ambientes;
  • Conhecimento em Linux (administração e troubleshooting);
  • Vivência em ambientes com alta disponibilidade, performance crítica e observabilidade madura;
  • Familiaridade com protocolo AMQP, mensageria assíncrona, conceitos de backpressure, ack/nack, redelivery, etc;
  • Experiência com troubleshooting avançado (latência, vazamento de mensagens, filas zumbis);
  • Administrar e evoluir ambientes distribuídos de RabbitMQ (on-premises e/ou cloud);
  • Planejar, configurar e manter topologias, exchanges, queues, bindings, políticas e limites;
  • Implementar políticas de alta disponibilidade (HA), replicação e resiliência para clusters RabbitMQ;
  • Monitorar performance e saúde dos brokers com ferramentas como Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, ELK ou outros;
  • Automatizar provisionamento e operações com ferramentas como Ansible e Terraform;
  • Atuar em incidentes críticos e troubleshooting de problemas de performance, vazamento de mensagens, filas travadas, etc;
  • Suportar e orientar times de desenvolvimento no uso eficiente do RabbitMQ (boas práticas de consumo, retry, dead-letter, etc.);
  • Produzir e manter documentação técnica atualizada, playbooks e manuais operacionais.

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência em ambientes regulados (financeiro);
  • Experiência com ambientes Kubernetes usando RabbitMQ Operator ou charts Helm;
  • Vivência com integração de mensageria com sistemas distribuídos, microsserviços e eventos de negócio;
  • Conhecimento básico em Kafka, IBM MQ, IBM Sterling Connect:Direct ou outras tecnologias de fila/mensageria;
